properties.entry: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM, A.* FROM ( SELECT B.BOARD_NO, B.BOARD_TITLE, B.BOARD_WRITER, M.MEMBER_NAME, B.COUNT, B.CREATE_DATE AS CREATE_DATE, C.CATEGORY_NAME FROM BOARD B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.BOARD_WRITER = M.MEMBER_NO JOIN CATEGORY C ON B.CATEGORY_NO = C.CATEGORY_NO WHERE B.STATUS = 'Y' AND B.BOARD_TYPE = 1 ORDER BY B.BOARD_NO DESC ) A ) WHERE RNUM BETWEEN ? AND ?
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD B WHERE B.STATUS = 'Y' AND B.BOARD_TYPE = 1
SELECT CATEGORY_NO, CATEGORY_NAME FROM CATEGORY WHERE CATEGORY_NO != 10 ORDER BY CATEGORY_NO
INSERT INTO BOARD ( BOARD_NO, BOARD_TYPE, CATEGORY_NO, BOARD_TITLE, BOARD_CONTENT, BOARD_WRITER ) VALUES ( SEQ_BNO.NEXTVAL, 1, ?, ?, ?, ? )

SELECT B.BOARD_NO, B.BOARD_TYPE, B.CATEGORY_NO, C.CATEGORY_NAME, B.BOARD_TITLE, B.BOARD_CONTENT, B.BOARD_WRITER, M.MEMBER_NAME, B.COUNT, B.CREATE_DATE AS CREATE_DATE FROM BOARD B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.BOARD_WRITER = M.MEMBER_NO JOIN CATEGORY C ON B.CATEGORY_NO = C.CATEGORY_NO WHERE B.BOARD_NO = ? AND B.STATUS = 'Y'
UPDATE BOARD SET COUNT = COUNT + 1 WHERE BOARD_NO = ?
UPDATE BOARD SET CATEGORY_NO = ?, BOARD_TITLE = ?, BOARD_CONTENT = ? WHERE BOARD_NO = ? AND BOARD_WRITER = ? AND STATUS = 'Y'
UPDATE BOARD SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE BOARD_NO = ? AND BOARD_WRITER = ? AND STATUS = 'Y'
